_comment: This is a very small example mod that overrides the Quarters building and turns it into Mega-Quarters. Access-Control-Allow-Origin on the file server must allow https://castle-digger.com and the header must be application/json.

building-bedroom-servants.name: Mega-Quarters
building-bedroom-servants.description: A place to sleep for AN ARMY. Prevents tiredness. Quite cuddlesome indeed and noone pays you rent.
